enchantments.tooltip: Charisma +13: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Potency +98: Passive: +98 Equipment bonus to each Spell Power.
Exceptional Alluring Skills Bonus: +10 Exceptional bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, Haggle, Intimidate, and Perform.
Use Magic Device +5: Passive: +5 Competence bonus to the Use Magic Device skill.
Trace of Madness: You can almost hear faint, panicked voices when this item is close to you. Perhaps the latent power of this item's hint of madness could be brought out by some catalyst.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
